description: Playwright coverage and the DEV-only test-mode env flag. Adds the unit-harness spec (pure helpers), routing/login specs (production preview build), RBAC/offline list/detail/status specs (dev server + flag with in-memory fixtures), and an optional live-credential spec. Depends on FEAT-001/002 (the modules and UI under test) and FEAT-003 (so the full app builds); the DEV+flag guards it exercises were implemented in FEAT-001/002.
steps: Add VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE= (empty) to .env.example with a comment: DEV-only Playwright test flag; must never be set for a deploy build; has no effect on a production bundle because the guard also requires import.meta.env.DEV.

Verify (do not re-implement unless missing) that src/admin/AuthContext.tsx, src/lib/applications.ts, and src/lib/adminApi.ts each check import.meta.env.DEV && import.meta.env.VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE === '1' as the FIRST statement of their data-access entry points and return fakes/fixtures with no firebase service call. If any is missing the guard, add it (this is the double-gated, tree-shaken-in-prod override from the design).

Create tests/unit.spec.ts: Playwright test() blocks with NO page (pure runtime harness, intentionally outside the tsc project set). Import the pure helpers from ../src/lib and assert: roles.ts predicates for each role (canManageAdmins only superadmin; canEditApplications admin+superadmin; canExport per design); genderLabelHe('7')==='זכר', ('0')==='נקבה', ('1')==='אחר', (undefined)==='לא צוין', ('')==='לא צוין'; status label map values; toCsv output starts with the UTF-8 BOM and correctly escapes a cell containing a comma/quote/newline; formatDateHe returns a he-IL formatted string for a known ISO input.

Create tests/admin-routing.spec.ts (runs against the production vite preview build): visiting /admin unauthenticated redirects to /admin/login; /admin/login renders the Hebrew email+password form and submit button. Use const SITE = process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://negev.sb0.tech' like existing specs.

Create tests/admin-rbac.spec.ts (runs against the dev server with DEV=true + VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE=1): for each role set window.__ADMIN_TEST_ROLE__ before load (e.g. via page.addInitScript). viewer -> no 'ניהול מנהלים' nav item, no status/export controls; admin -> sees applications controls (status select, export) but no admin-management nav; superadmin -> sees everything including 'ניהול מנהלים'. Also cover the list/detail/status happy path over the in-memory fixtures (open a fixture application, change status, assert the audit entry appears) and the status filter over fixtures (client-side, no index dependency).

Create tests/admin-live.spec.ts: real signInWithEmailAndPassword against a seeded user, with test.skip(!process.env.ADMIN_TEST_EMAIL || !process.env.ADMIN_TEST_PASSWORD, 'requires live admin credentials') at the top so it is skipped by default.
acceptance_criteria: With a production preview running (npm run build then npx vite preview --port 4173), SITE_URL=http://localhost:4173 npx playwright test tests/admin-routing.spec.ts --project=desktop passes.
With the dev server running under VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE=1, SITE_URL=http://localhost:5173 npx playwright test tests/admin-rbac.spec.ts --project=desktop passes.
tests/admin-live.spec.ts is skipped when live credentials are absent.
.env.example contains VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE= with the DEV-only comment.
verification: npm run build ; npx vite preview --port 4173 (background) ; $env:SITE_URL='http://localhost:4173'; npx playwright test tests/admin-routing.spec.ts --project=desktop
$env:VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE='1'; npm run dev (background) ; $env:SITE_URL='http://localhost:5173'; npx playwright test tests/admin-rbac.spec.ts --project=desktop
findings:
DONE. Added VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE= (empty) to .env.example with the DEV-only comment. Verified the DEV+flag guard is the first statement of every data-access entry point in AuthContext.tsx (TestModeProvider short-circuits with a synchronous fake, no onAuthStateChanged), applications.ts (fixtures, no Firestore query) and adminApi.ts (fixture mutation, no callable) — all present from FEAT-001/002, none needed adding. Created tests/unit.spec.ts (9 tests, pure helpers, no page), tests/admin-routing.spec.ts (2 tests, prod preview), tests/admin-rbac.spec.ts (5 tests, dev server + flag + in-memory fixtures via window.__ADMIN_TEST_ROLE__ set with page.addInitScript), tests/admin-live.spec.ts (1 test, test.skip on missing ADMIN_TEST_EMAIL/PASSWORD).

VERIFICATION (all green): npm run build exit 0; npm run lint exit 0 (zero warnings); unit.spec 9 passed; admin-routing.spec 2 passed against `npx vite preview --port 4173` with SITE_URL=http://localhost:4173; admin-rbac.spec 5 passed against `npx vite --port 5173` with VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE=1 and SITE_URL=http://localhost:5173; admin-live.spec 1 skipped with no credentials.

ROOT-CAUSE FIX (affects a FEAT-001 file — src/lib/firebase.ts, additive, behavior-preserving): unit.spec imports genderLabelHe + STATUS_LABEL_HE from applications.ts, which transitively imports firebase.ts whose top-level getAuth(app) runs at module load. Under Playwright's standalone esbuild `import.meta.env` is undefined (not a Vite runtime), so (a) reading import.meta.env.* threw, and (b) getAuth threw auth/invalid-api-key on an undefined key. Fix: firebase.ts now reads `const env = import.meta.env ?? {inert placeholder config}` and applications.ts isTestMode() uses `const env = import.meta.env ?? {}`. Under Vite (dev/build/preview) import.meta.env is ALWAYS an object, so the fallback branch is never taken and real VITE_FIREBASE_* behavior (including a genuinely-missing var surfacing as undefined) is byte-for-byte unchanged; the placeholders are only used by the Node unit-spec harness, where no firebase service method is ever called (the DEV+flag guards short-circuit first). The design asserts the top-level init is 'lazy and harmless'; this makes that literally true under the Node harness too. No change to the public apply flow, ApplyWizard, webhook.ts, main.tsx, or functions exports.apply.

TEST-ASSUMPTION CORRECTION (no app behavior changed): the FEAT-004 step wording said 'viewer -> no status/export controls', but the authoritative design defines canExport as viewer-and-up (roles.ts: ROLE_RANK[role] >= ROLE_RANK.viewer; confirmed by the passing unit assertion canExport('viewer')===true) and ApplicationsPage renders the CSV export button whenever canExport is true. The export button is therefore correctly visible to a viewer (client-side export of data the viewer already reads). The admin-rbac viewer test asserts: no 'ניהול מנהלים' nav, export button VISIBLE, and NO status <select> on the detail view (write control is gated). FOR LATER STEPS: do not 'fix' the viewer export button to be hidden — that would contradict the approved design; if the product truly wants viewers unable to export, that is a design change (adjust canExport) not a test change.

Notes for later steps: admin component Hebrew selectors used by the specs are stable text anchors — nav link 'ניהול מנהלים', heading 'מועמדים', button 'ייצוא CSV', combobox aria-label 'סינון לפי סטטוס', status <select> class 'adm-select', login title 'כניסת מנהלים' + button 'התחברות', topbar 'Negev Talent · ניהול'. Fixtures live in applications.ts: fixture-1 דנה כהן (new), fixture-2 יוסי לוי (contacted, has seeded history actorEmail asaf@sb0.tech), fixture-3 אבי מזרחי (interview, legacy HTTP shape). Public form-submit.spec.ts was NOT run here (environment_constraints forbids live Firestore/Make.com); my only public-path touch is the never-taken firebase.ts fallback branch.
